tasks.summary_pl: Oblicz $x$: 15 to przybliżenie $x$ z niedomiarem, błąd 0,24
tasks.summary_en: Find $x$: 15 approximates $x$ from below with absolute error 0.24
tasks.statement_en:
The number $15$ is an approximation by deficiency of the number $x$. The absolute error of this approximation equals $0.24$. The number $x$ is:
A. $14.76$
B. $14.80$
C. $15.20$
D. $15.24$

tasks.summary_en: Diagonal of a square from side midpoints $(7,1)$, $(9,7)$
tasks.statement_en:
Points $E=(7,1)$ and $F=(9,7)$ are the midpoints of sides $AB$ and $BC$, respectively, of square $ABCD$. The diagonal of this square has length:
A. $4\sqrt5$
B. $10$
C. $4\sqrt{10}$
D. $20$

The number $\left(\dfrac{3+\sqrt3}{\sqrt3}\right)^2$ equals:
A. $4$
B. $9$
C. $\dfrac{3+\sqrt3}{3}$
D. $4+2\sqrt3$

The number $3^{\frac94}$ equals:
A. $3\cdot\sqrt[4]{3}$
B. $9\cdot\sqrt[4]{3}$
C. $27\cdot\sqrt[4]{3}$
D. $3^9\cdot 3^{\frac14}$

The exponential function given by the formula $f(x)=3^x$ takes the value $6$ for the argument:
A. $x=2$
B. $x=\log_3 2$
C. $x=\log_3 6$
D. $x=\log_6 3$

tasks.notes: Wybor poprawnej faktoryzacji wyrazenia 16-(3x+1)^2 (wyrazenie algebraiczne, nie liczba).
Zbiorem rozwiazan nierownosci jest przedzial liczbowy.

tasks.summary_pl: Ile procent klasy stanowią dziewczęta (4x więcej chłopców)?
tasks.summary_en: What percent of the class are girls (4x more boys)?
tasks.statement_en:
In a class there are four times more boys than girls. What percentage of all the students in this class are girls?
A. $4\%$
B. $5\%$
C. $20\%$
D. $25\%$

The remainder of dividing the number $55$ by $8$ equals:
A. $4$
B. $5$
C. $6$
D. $7$

The function $f$ assigns to every natural number greater than $1$ its largest prime divisor. Among the numbers $f(42)$, $f(44)$, $f(45)$, $f(48)$, the largest is:
A. $f(42)$
B. $f(44)$
C. $f(45)$
D. $f(48)$

tasks.notes: Odpowiedz to nazwa kata (np. OSC), nie wartosc liczbowa.
Wskazanie prawdziwej rownosci f(1)=f(9) wynikajacej z symetrii paraboli (stwierdzenie).

tasks.statement_en:
If the angle $\alpha$ is acute and $\tan\alpha=\dfrac34$, then $\dfrac{2-\cos\alpha}{2+\cos\alpha}$ equals:
A. $-1$
B. $-\dfrac13$
C. $\dfrac37$
D. $\dfrac{84}{25}$

The equation $(2x-1)(x-2)=(1-2x)(x+2)$ has two solutions. These are the numbers:
A. $-2$ and $\dfrac12$
B. $0$ and $\dfrac12$
C. $\dfrac12$ and $2$
D. $-2$ and $2$

tasks.notes: Wybor rownania tworzacego uklad sprzeczny z danym (odpowiedz to rownanie).

tasks.topic_en: Trigonometric ratios in a right triangle
tasks.summary_pl: Sinus kąta ostrego w trójkącie prostokątnym (rysunek)
tasks.summary_en: Sine of the acute angle in a right triangle (figure)
tasks.statement_en:
In the triangle shown in the figure below, the sine of the acute angle $\alpha$ equals: [Figure: a right triangle with the right angle at the bottom-left vertex, a leg of length $1$ adjacent to angle $\alpha$ at the top vertex, and the hypotenuse of length $5$ connecting the top vertex to the bottom-right vertex.]
A. $\dfrac15$
B. $\dfrac{\sqrt6}{12}$
C. $\dfrac{5}{24}$
D. $\dfrac{2\sqrt6}{5}$

tasks.notes: Odpowiedz to zaleznosc r = (1/2) l miedzy dwiema zmiennymi (wyrazenie), nie pojedyncza liczba.

tasks.summary_en: Circles of radii 10, 15 - distance between centers
tasks.statement_en:
Two circles with radii $10$ and $15$ are given. The smaller circle passes through the center of the larger circle. The distance between the centers of these circles equals:
A. $2.5$
B. $5$
C. $10$
D. $12.5$

tasks.summary_pl: Liczba uścisków dłoni w grupie 12 osób
tasks.summary_en: Number of handshakes in a group of 12 people
tasks.statement_en:
Every participant of a meeting of a twelve-person group of friends shook hands with every other member of the group. The total number of handshakes was equal to:
A. $66$
B. $72$
C. $132$
D. $144$

In a nine-term geometric sequence with positive terms, the first term equals $3$ and the last term equals $12$. The fifth term of this sequence equals:
A. $3\sqrt[4]2$
B. $6$
C. $7\frac12$
D. $8\frac17$

The sequence $(a_n)$ is given by the formula $a_n=(n+3)(n-5)$ for $n\ge1$. The number of negative terms of this sequence equals:
A. $3$
B. $4$
C. $7$
D. $9$

tasks.notes: Wskazanie prawdziwej rownosci miedzy prawdopodobienstwami p_i (stwierdzenie).

tasks.statement_en: The solution set of the inequality $ax+4\ge0$ with unknown $x$ is the interval $(-\infty, 2]$. Determine $a$. Show your working.
Solve the equation $\dfrac{x(x+1)}{x-1}=5x-4$, for $x\ne1$. Show your working.

tasks.notes: Pole kwadratu K12 = a^2/4^11 zalezy od nieustalonej dlugosci boku a (wyrazenie, nie liczba).
Wykaz, ze pole pierscienia nie zalezy od promieni (dowod).

tasks.summary_pl: Promień okręgu opisanego na trójkącie o bokach $\sqrt7,\sqrt8,\sqrt{15}$
tasks.summary_en: Circumradius of a triangle with sides $\sqrt7,\sqrt8,\sqrt{15}$
tasks.statement_en: A circle is circumscribed on a triangle with side lengths $\sqrt7$, $\sqrt8$, $\sqrt{15}$. Calculate the radius of this circle.

tasks.topic_en: Line in the plane - area of a triangle
tasks.summary_pl: Proste $l,k$ przez $A=(0,4)$: pole trójkąta z osią $Ox$
tasks.summary_en: Lines $l,k$ through $A=(0,4)$: area of triangle with the $Ox$ axis
tasks.statement_en: Lines $l$ and $k$ intersect at point $A=(0,4)$. Line $l$ forms, together with the positive semi-axes of the coordinate system, a triangle of area $8$, while line $k$ forms a triangle of area $10$. Calculate the area of the triangle whose vertices are: point $A$ and the points where lines $l$ and $k$ intersect the $Ox$ axis. Show your working.

tasks.summary_pl: Ala i Ola: kiedy Ola wyprzedziła Alę? (min. po 7:00)
tasks.summary_en: Ala and Ola: when did Ola overtake Ala? (minutes after 7:00)
tasks.statement_en: Ala rides her bike to school, and Ola rides a scooter. Both cover the same route. Ala left for school at 7:00 and covered the whole route in 40 minutes. Ola left 10 minutes later than Ala, and covering the whole route took her only 20 minutes. Calculate the clock time at which Ola overtook Ala. Show your working.
tasks.notes: Key gives clock time 7:20; value encodes this as minutes elapsed after Ala's 7:00 departure (20). [verified: ok: st/40=s(t-10)/20 -> t=20, i.e. 7:20; summary fixes unit (min. po 7:00). Minor: summary lacks diacritics (wyprzedziła Alę).]
Wyznacz rownanie prostej przechodzacej przez D rownoleglej do BC (wyrazenie, rownanie prostej).

tasks.summary_pl: Stosunek pól powierzchni sześcianu i graniastosłupa
tasks.summary_en: Ratio of surface areas of a cube and a prism
tasks.statement_en: Jacek plays with cube-shaped blocks with edge length $2\text{ cm}$. He built from them one large cube with edge length $8\text{ cm}$, using all of his blocks. He then knocked down the structure and built from these blocks a second solid - a regular quadrilateral prism (a cuboid with a square base). It turned out that he had exactly one block left over, with nowhere to add it. Calculate the ratio of the total surface area of the first solid built to the total surface area of the second solid, and give the result as an irreducible fraction. Show your working.
